changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 2 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6475-gantt-block-face-declared.md`

- names `plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx` → `packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx` — edited by this change

  > The `gantt` nested-block spelling of a gantt config (`{ type: 'object-gantt', gantt: { … } }`) had **no mirror entry at all**: it rode through `BaseSchema`'s `.passthrough()` entirely unvalidated, and the published TypeScript never taught the shape either — an author writing `gantt: { … }` got no completion, no type checking, no error on a misspelt member. It was the 28th and last of the keys `getGanttConfig` (`plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx`) reads off the schema that objectui#6051 (PR #6472) did not declare — severed into its own card because, unlike the other 27, declaring it changes what a published tool refuses.

### `.changeset/6939-objectql-record-source-refinement.md`

- names `plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx` → `packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx` — edited by this change

  > Both renderers resolve their records from one of three keys, in this order — `getDataConfig` in `plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx` and `plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx`: `data`, then `staticData`, then `objectName`. Both mirrors required `objectName` alone, so a document authored on `staticData` drew correctly and was refused by `safeValidateSchema` — six catalog entries, three per component.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `5add18a67` (merge-base with origin/main): 2 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1482 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2066 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36137122802)

### ① Derived judgments

**Success, not start.** Triage `5831854083` said "starts or succeeds … as `ObjectGrid` does"; success-only is inside that disjunction. The overtaking reasoning is real at source, read on head `ObjectGantt.tsx`: `reload()` takes `seq` at 810-811; the invalidation effect calls `reloadRef.current({ silent: true })` at 1059 with the latest closure, so a silent run issued after a query change re-reads the CHANGED query and takes over `isCurrent()`; the changed run's commit (910), report (933) and `finally` (954) are all skipped as non-current, and the silent run's failure only logs (930-932). So with a start clear the end state is the previous query's rows, no error, no refreshing. Reproduced: ablation A3 (`if (!silent) setError(null)` after line 814, the commit-1 shape) turns exactly pin 7 red, "the error was cleared although nothing answered the current query" (1 failed / 6 passed). User-visible cost of success-only: after the first paint a changed query while the error screen is up shows NO in-flight feedback. My probe P2 on head: `errorScreenStillUp true, placeholder false, refreshing false, chart false` until the answer lands; identical on the base blob. The `RefreshIndicator` (2224) and the toolbar refresh (2314) both sit behind the `if (error)` early return at 2047, and the error screen itself has no retry affordance. Pre-paint the placeholder wins because `loading` is checked first (2037; pin 1 line 161). This is not newly hidden, but it is the objectui#10539 in-place refreshing state being invisible from the error screen, and the PR body states it. Residual, not a blocker.

**Every exit of a current reload, and what happens to `error`:** host `data` array (816-826): committed, cleared at 822. Adapter `find` success (909-928): committed, cleared at 926. Empty result: same branch, `setData([])` and cleared; probe P3 on head `anyErrorShown false` (base: `true`). Config-invalid: no early return inside `reload()`; `if (!ganttConfig)` lives in the render at 2057, after `if (error)`, so it does not commit or clear and cannot bypass the fix. Thrown (852 `DataSource required`, or `find` rejecting): `catch` sets `error` only when non-silent and current (933-937); silent failures log only. Abort: there is no AbortController; a superseded run skips commit, report and `finally` (all under `isCurrent()`), so `error` is untouched (pin 5; ablation A1 turns it red, 1 failed / 6 passed). Unmount: no cleanup; a late resolution is a React no-op. Every SUCCESS path passes through one of the two commit branches; no success path leaves `error` set. All 14 `setData(` sites checked: the 12 outside `reload()` (1870-2171) are optimistic edits reachable only from the mounted chart, so never while the error screen is up.

**Silent semantics.** Silent success after an error clears it: the silent run re-reads the current query through the latest closure, so its rows answer it; right, and it matches the grid's re-read end state on success (`ObjectGrid.tsx` 1870-1871 clears at load start, then rows land). Silent failure after an error keeps the old error: right for the product (the last report about the current query stands). One asymmetry the body does not claim otherwise: the grid's re-read REPORTS its own failure (2328-2329); the gantt's silent one never does, by objectui#7237 design.

**Pins.** Scratch worktree at head, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline` from the local store, no build needed (vitest aliases `@object-ui/*` to src). Head: `Tests 7 passed (7)`. Base leg with `ObjectGantt.tsx` swapped to blob `cdd9bca99` (`objectui#10578` in file: 0): `Tests 3 failed | 4 passed (7)`, red = the two fail-then-succeed pins and the silent-success pin, matching the body. A1: 1 failed (superseded). A3: 1 failed (overtaking). Restore proven each time: blob `31b21cc232b0` equals HEAD, `git diff --stat` empty. The controls are real; the four green-on-base pins are honestly labelled as ablation-only.

**The dev's out-of-scope overtaking finding** is real at source (lines above). My probe P1 (no prior error; changed query in flight; silent re-read overtakes; changed run SUCCEEDS and is discarded; silent run fails): first-query rows shown, changed rows absent, no error, no refreshing, on head and base alike (4/4 probe assertions both legs). P4 (starting from an error): the stale `Error: Q2 failed` stays up while the changed query's successful rows are discarded, and `$orderby` of the changed run equals the silent run's; identical on head and base. This PR makes it neither better nor worse. A card IS owed: the report grades it class a with a named site and reproduction, the body says only "reported to the seat", and a scan of the 100 most recently updated objectui items for `overtak` or `silent re-read` plus `changed`/`supersed` finds none.

### ② Semver level

`'@object-ui/plugin-gantt': patch` is right: a bug fix in one released package (17.6.0), no export, prop, schema or accept set moves; `Clause-②: no` holds. Changeset sentence by sentence: true, with one imprecision, "sets `error` when the current reload fails" omits "non-silent", which the next paragraphs restore. PR body sentence by sentence: the mechanism, the `ObjectGrid` precedent (1870-1871), the measured A3 outcome, the pre-paint placeholder, the post-paint "behind the error screen exactly as on base", the pins table, and the local counts all check (my full package run: `Test Files 78 passed (78)`, `Tests 595 passed (595)`; eslint on the two files: 0 errors, 84 and 7 warnings, same as claimed). The two commits are described honestly: `226f56c35` carries `if (!silent) setError(null);` at reload start plus 6 cases; `49ba9b84e` removes it, adds pin 7 and retitles pin 2 (dropping "under its refreshing state while in flight", consistent with the changed behaviour). Squash lands the final state.
